  <bpmn:process id="Process_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Character creation started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Start two activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Names</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CheckBnet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Names" name="Come up with character names">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Names_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBnet" name="Check battle.net account">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckBnet_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetExists" name="Battle.net account exists?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckBnet_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BnetExists_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BnetExists_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInfo" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterAccount_Click</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmation" name="Click confirmation link in confirmation mail">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Click_AccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountMerge" name="Battle.net account ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BnetExists_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Click_AccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountMerge_CheckSub</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckSubscription" name="Check active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckSub_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubActive" name="WoW subscription active?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckSub_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubActive_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubActive_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPayment" name="Select payment method">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectPayment_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Payment method?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectPayment_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Bank</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCard" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterIban" name="Enter IBAN and BIC numbers">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Iban_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Subscription and payment settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubActive_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Iban_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join" name="Account set up and names prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Names_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_Realm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Realm_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterName" name="Enter character name">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterName_Available</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Name available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterName_Available</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameTaken_Retry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm_Expansion</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Expansion_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Expansion" messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Done" name="Character created and expansion notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Expansion_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Names" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_Names"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckBnet" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckBnet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBnet_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBnet" targetRef="Gateway_BnetExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetExists_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetExists_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetExists" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAccount_Click" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Click_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_CheckSub" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSub_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_SubActive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubActive_Yes" name="Active" sourceRef="Gateway_SubActive" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubActive_No" name="Not active" sourceRef="Gateway_SubActive" targetRef="Task_SelectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_SelectPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_CreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Bank" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterIban"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCard" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Iban_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterIban" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Names_Join" sourceRef="Task_Names" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_Realm" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_SelectRealm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Realm_EnterName" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealm" targetRef="Task_EnterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_Available" sourceRef="Task_EnterName" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameTaken_Retry" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_Confirm" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_Expansion" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleased"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expansion_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleased" targetRef="EndEvent_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description lists several distinct actions in one clause, separated by commas or 'and', that are performed by the same actor (for example the system or the customer), and each action is described as its own step: Model each listed action as its own task, labelled with its own verb-object phrase, and do not merge the list into one task. If the listed actions have no stated order, fork them from the preceding step with a parallel split gateway, one unconditional flow to each task, and join them with a parallel gateway before the next step that needs all of them to be complete.
rules.situation: the description has one clause in which a single participant enters or selects several objects joined by commas or 'and' (for example identifiers or attributes), with no stated order among them, and a later step needs all of them

rules.instruction: When the description states, within one sentence, several distinct actions that a user performs, such as entering two different data items or choosing several separate attributes: Model each stated action as its own user task, placed in the order the description gives, and do not combine them into a single task whose label lists all of them. Keep the stated order of the actions as sequence flow between the tasks.
rules.situation: the description states, within one sentence, several distinct actions that a user performs, such as entering two different data items or choosing several separate attributes

rules.instruction: When the description states that an exclusive decision is followed, on one branch only, by an action that a party performs (for example approving a result, or launching a follow-up activity): Model that stated action as its own task placed after the exclusive decision gateway on that branch, and continue the flow from that task. Do not replace it with a send task, an expanded subprocess, or a bare flow, and do not omit it because it appears only on one branch.
rules.situation: the description states that an exclusive check of whether a prerequisite exists leads, on the branch where it does not exist, to a user action that supplies data and is followed by a confirmation step on that same branch

rules.instruction: When the description states that one step is followed by several actions that the same actor performs without a stated order, and all of them must be carried out before the process moves on: Model a parallel gateway that forks into one branch per stated action, and a parallel gateway that joins those branches before the next step. Do not connect the actions in a sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway, because all branches must complete.
rules.situation: the description states that, after a choice, several items or actions are to be carried out within one branch, listed with 'and' and without a stated order, and the process continues only after all of them are done

rules.instruction: When the description names several activities that are carried out side by side, with no stated order among them, and a later step starts only after all of them are finished: Model a parallel split gateway before the group of activities, with one unconditional outgoing flow to each activity. Join the activities with a parallel join gateway, and connect one outgoing flow from that join to the later step. Do not add decision conditions to these branches, and do not chain the activities in sequence when the description does not order them.
rules.situation: the description says that while one sequence of steps is under way, a separate sequence of steps can already be carried out (for example 'while you are doing X, you can already do Y'), with no stated order between the two and the later step needing the separate sequence to be finished
